heroHeadline: Official: Bad Bunny to Close World Tour With Two Homecoming Shows at Hiram Bithorn, Aug 22–23
heroSubtitle: Bad Bunny and Rimas Entertainment have officially confirmed two "Debí Tirar Más Fotos – Cerramos en Casa" shows at Estadio Hiram Bithorn in San Juan on August 22 and 23, ending weeks of speculation fueled by stadium construction and sponsor teasers. Tickets go on sale August 19 through PRticket.com ($50–$100), with a Banco Popular cardholder presale the same day. The homecoming shows give the record-breaking, $467.5 million-grossing Debí Tirar Más Fotos World Tour — which technically closed July 22 in Brussels — a coda in the country where it launched via the sold-out Coliseo residency.
